skill.name: Heradon's Protection
skill.description:
Passive: Other echelon members gain a #1-point shield and #2 evasion increase when they first take damage, lasting until the end of the battle. The buff effects are doubled on P90.
Active: Reduce all enemy units' damage by #3 for #4 seconds and dispel all shields on non-Boss enemy units once.

skill.name: Dazzling Six-Fold Strike
skill.description:
Passive: Every normal attack deals 6 instances of 20% damage, with each instance applying a normal attack's effect. After attacking for a total of 300 times (including her Dummy-Links' attacks), reduce all enemy units' evasion by 100% and inflict 10% vulnerability on them, lasting 8 seconds.
Active: Increase self damage by #1 and evasion of allies on buff tiles by #2, lasting #3 seconds.

skill.name: Hunting Mark
skill.description:
Passive: Receive one stack of Hunting Mark for every critical hit, capped at 25 stacks. Every time this unit participates in the successful killing of a target, convert all accumulated stacks of Hunting Mark into buffs, with each stack providing 2% damage and rate of fire increase for 10 seconds.
Active: Immediately convert Hunting Marks and mark the highest HP enemy, directing the entire echelon to focus fire at it for #1 seconds. If the target is killed during the active skill, the entire echelon receives the effect of 5 converted Hunting Marks. (Not affected by the cap of 25 Hunting Marks.)

skill.name: Crisis Management
skill.description:
Passive: Every time a dummy link is lost, increase damage by 25% and gain 25% damage reduction for 99 seconds.
Active: Increase damage and critical rate of the entire echelon by #1 for #2 seconds. For every enemy within a range of 6 units, additionally increase self damage and critical rate by 5% with a cap of 5 stacks, this effect lasting #3 seconds.

skill.name: Second-Place Bonus
skill.description: Make a check after every 3 seconds; if self's damage dealt is not the top among the ARs in the echelon, increase damage, accuracy and critical rate by #1 for 100 seconds.

skill.name: Lock-On Shield
skill.description:
Passive: This unit gains a shield when reloading that provides #1 damage reduction to self and gives all allies in the column in front a 100 HP shield, lasting for #2 seconds.
Active: Turn on Lock-On mode for #3 seconds, which enables this unit to attack without consuming ammo or reloading. This unit will prioritize the highest HP enemy, with each attack or critical hit increasing self damage by #4. (Changing the target or ending Lock-On mode clears this buff.)

skill.name: Coordinates Locked
skill.description:
Switch between attack modes by clicking the skill in battle. Initial default is Upright Shooting Mode.
Upright Shooting Mode: Attack the furthest enemy unit, dealing #1 damage with the first attack on each target and reducing their move speed and evasion by #2 for 3 seconds. When switching to this mode, increase damage and accuracy by #3 until switching to another mode.
Hip Shooting Mode: Attack the nearest enemy unit, dealing two instances of #4 damage. The lower the target's HP, the higher the damage (increase damage by 8% for every 10% target's HP lost, with damage increase capping at 30%). When switching to this mode, accuracy is reduced by 50% until switching to another mode.
Prone Shooting Mode: Attack an enemy elite unit, and increase self damage and accuracy by #5 for every successive attack on the same target to a maximum of 10 stacks. The number of stacks is halved when switching to another target and drops to zero when switching to another mode. When switching to this mode, increase accuracy by 50% until switching to another mode.

skill.name: Cursed Puppet
skill.description:
Passive: If this unit enters battle with a silencer equipped, when receiving buffs from an evasion-buffing skill during this battle (includes fairies), additionally increase this unit's evasion by 20% for 5 seconds, to a maximum of 3 stacks (this effect does not trigger itself).
Active: Deal 50 points of damage to this unit and all units on this unit's buff tiles, then reduce all enemies' evasion by #1 for #2 seconds. If this damage is enough to kill this unit, all enemy units' firepower and attack speed are additionally reduced by #3 for 20 seconds.

skill.name: Acherontia Prelude
skill.description:
The more HP lost by this unit, the more damage dealt, to a maximum of 300%. When enemy units lose dummy-links, gain 1 point(s) of Geist and when ally units lose dummy-links, gain  10 points of Geist. 
 Upon reaching 20 points of Geist, the next attack against the highest-threat enemy is enhanced to deal #1 damage, it is guaranteed to hit and this unit loses 20 points of Geist. After triggering 5 enhanced attacks, become immune to damage for 20 seconds after becoming heavily damaged during this battle.

skill.name: Glorious Penetrator
skill.description:
Passive: Damage dealt to lightly-armored enemies is increased by #1 and damage dealt to heavily-armored enemies is reduced by 20%. (Enemies with armor below 200 points are considered lightly-armored, otherwise they are considered heavily-armored)
Active: Reduce enemy armor by #2 for #3 seconds.

skill.name: Spicy Samba
skill.description:
Passive: Each attack deals additional damage equal to #1 of this unit's current HP and shield value damage multiplier. 
Active: Gain the damage and shield value multipliers of ally units on this unit's buff tiles for #2 seconds.

skill.name: Stylish Rhythm
skill.description: Increase this unit's damage by #1 for #2 seconds and cleanse all stat debuffs from all ally Dolls.

skill.name: Righteous Assembly
skill.description:
After the start of battle, receive a stream of 20 reinforcement Dolls who will advance in front of the echelon and attack. Reinforcement Dolls have #1 pointsof HP, cannot inflict critical hits and are not affected by status effects. All other stats and attack modes are the same as Unica's at the start of the battle. 
 Each group of enemies killed increases her damage by #2 points until the end of the battle. Each reinforcement Doll killed increases all allied Dolls' damage and rate of fire by #3 for 5 seconds.

skill.name: Case Deduction
skill.description:
Passive: At the start of battle, scan all enemies. If they are classified as High-Threat Targets, skill cooldowns are reduced by 40% for the duration of the battle and this skill applies an additional 20 points of shield.
Active: All ally units' rate of fire is increased by #1 points and their move speed is increased by 5 points for #2 seconds.

skill.name: Windward Navigation
skill.description:
During this battle, all ally units suffer a 50% evasion decrease and gain #1 damage reduction. 
Every 10 seconds, all ally SMG Dolls gain #2 points of damage. This effect can trigger up to 5 times and lasts until the end of battle. This buff cannot be removed.

skill.name: Teatime
skill.description:
Passive: At the start of battle, gain 200 points of armor for 20 seconds. This buff is lost after being hit 100 times. 
Active: Skill begins charging after cooldown ends, adding 1 charge per second, to a maximum of 30 charges. Clicking the skill button initiates aiming for 1.5 seconds, then expend all charges to make an attack on the furthest target which does #1 to #2 damage. If the target is a boss, this skill instead deals #3 to #4 damage.

skill.name: Bullet of the End
skill.description:
Passive: When this unit has a stat debuff, attacks are guaranteed to hit. If this unit suffers a rate of fire stat debuff, damage is increased in proportion to the amount of rate of fire reduction, to a maximum increase of 1000%. 
Active: Remove all allied Dolls' damage reduction and vulnerability effects, then fire a grenade whose damage scales with the number of Dummy-Links which deals 4x damage to all enemies within a 2.5 unit radius.

skill.name: Laceration Log
skill.description:
Passive: Attacks apply the Laceration effect (moving enemies take 50 points of damage per second, which scales with Dummy-Links) for #1 seconds. If only SG Dolls are present during this battle, this unit's damage increases by #2 points until the end of the battle. This effect cannot be removed.
Active: Attacks the three furthest enemies, deals #3 damage, and knocks them back by 10 units.

skill.name: Triphasic Fire Control
skill.description:
Passive: If there are 3/4/5 HG Dolls present at the start of the battle, increase this unit's damage by 100/150/200 points until the end of the battle. 
Active: This unit's rate of fire is reduced by #1 and each attack becomes 3 instances of #2 damage to all units within a 4 unit radius, can inflict critical hits and scales with Dummy-Links for #3 seconds.

skill.name: Affinity Excitation
skill.description: Increase the team leader Doll's rate of fire by #1 and increase the damage of ally reinforcement units by #2 for #3 seconds.

skill.name: Penetrating Rhythm
skill.description:
Passive: When ally units penetrate another unit's armor, they deal an additional 100 points of damage. 
Active: Increase all ally units' damage by #1 and their AP by #2 for #3 seconds.

skill.name: Sidestep Riposte
skill.description:
Passive: Each time this unit dodges an enemy attack, this unit's damage is increased by 10 points, stacking up to 100 times. 
Active: Increase this unit's evasion by  #1 and accuracy by #2 for #3 seconds.

skill.name: Scorching Overload
skill.description:
At the start of battle, increase this unit's damage by #1 and AP by #2 points for #3 seconds. Once this buff ends, this unit cannot gain it again and its rate of fire and accuracy are reduced by #4 until the end of the battle. 
For each enemy unit that dies, the duration of this buff is extended by 1 second. (Reinforcements that enter the battlefield after the start of the battle do not count)

skill.name: Absolute Counterattack
skill.description:
Passive: When attacked, there is a 10% chance to gain 1 points of armor,Maximum of 300 points. Every 100 times this unit is attacked, it deals #1 the amount of this unit's current armor to all enemy units.
Active: This unit's move speed is reduced to 0 and it taunts all enemy units. Damage taken by this unit is reduced by #2 points.,30% chance to gain armor per hit,for #3 seconds.

skill.name: Signal Broadcast
skill.description:
Each attack has a 5% chance to summon a Type 53 dummy-link,Part of this unit's stats are independently determined,HP is #1 points,Damage is #2 points,ROF is #3 points and it prioritizes attacking the nearest enemy units,All other stats are the same as Type 53.
Reinforcement units attack units with the Signal Broadcast effect.,Remains on the field for 5 seconds and can gain damage and attack speed buffs.
